VB-CABLE Virtual Audio Device
Copyright Vincent Burel / VB-Audio Softwares
https://vb-cable.com
https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm

VB-CABLE is donationware. All participations are welcome.

IronStack ships the official, unmodified VBCABLE_Driver_Pack45.zip and can
launch VB-Audio's own installer so viewer microphone audio can be injected
into the host's meeting microphone path (CABLE Input -> CABLE Output).

Per VB-Audio licensing, the donationware model remains applicable: end users
can identify VB-CABLE and may donate/pay at https://vb-cable.com if they find
it useful.
